title: Maps
subtitle: Your custom map library. A map replaces a Labs arena; the original is backed up and comes back in one click. Works while the game runs, from the main menu.

import.folderTitle: Import a folder of maps (e.g. a BakkesMod Workshop folder)

session.autoRestore: the stock arena comes back when the game closes

library.search: Search by name, author or tag
library.dropHint: Tip: drag & drop files or folders anywhere
library.emptyDescription: Import .upk/.zip files, a Workshop folder, or download maps from the Browse tab.

card.installHint: Replace the Labs arena with this map (Underpass by default)
card.installHintLive: Swap now — go back to the main menu first if you are on this arena
card.playOfflineHint: Swap and start the game offline, without EAC
card.replacesHint: Labs arena this map replaces (change it in Edit)

edit.title: Edit map
edit.name: Name
edit.targetHint: Pick the Labs map you will load from Free Play → Custom training. Underpass works for most maps.

delete.title: Delete this map?
delete.description: {{name}} will be removed from your library.
delete.warning: The map files are deleted from the app's library folder. This cannot be undone.

browse.externalHint: Download in your browser, then drop the file here.
browse.lethamyrNote: Lethamyr hosts its files on Google Drive, which this app does not download from. Open a map page, download it in your browser, then drag the file into this window.

toast.nothingImported: No map found in what you dropped
toast.installed: {{name}} installed — load it from Free Play in the Labs arena
toast.launchedHint: The game is starting without EAC. The stock arena comes back when you close it.
toast.liveHint: Load the Labs arena from Free Play to play it.
toast.launchedEpicHint: In the Epic Games Launcher, click ⋯ next to Rocket League, then "Launch without Anti-Cheat". The stock arena comes back when you close the game.

textures.title: Custom map textures
textures.ok: Installed: custom maps show their real textures and skybox.
textures.why: Many custom maps need this pack (14 engine files, ~47 MB, from bakkesplugins) or they show missing textures. Everyone playing the map needs it.

repair.title: Repair "{{name}}"
repair.description: Rocket League updates move or rename some arena objects that custom maps reuse (walls, skies, materials); the game then shows a blue and white checkerboard. Repairing re-points those references to where the objects are now.
repair.unsupported: This map cannot be repaired (compressed or not a UDK map).
repair.nothing: Mapping v{{version}} has nothing to fix in this map.
repair.keepNote: The original file is kept: you can go back to it at any time. The map keeps its name, thumbnail and settings.
repair.badgeRepairedHint: Repaired copy in use; the original is kept
repair.badgeRepairableHint: Some objects of this map moved in a game update: repair it to fix the checkerboard textures
repair.originalDetail: The map as downloaded or imported (always kept)
repair.defaultNote: The default version is the one Install and Play offline use. You can also pick a version when hosting.
